notes.title: Skel Dungeon: Heroes Must Die! is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of another new title from Buff Studio, Skel Dungeon!

[previewyoutube=DNQVpWXUdWU;full][/previewyoutube]
Skel Dungeon is a real-time strategy defense game. Become a small skeleton and defeat the heroes invading your dungeon. Set up and upgrade trap rooms, expand your dungeon, and strengthen your skeleton to stand against increasingly powerful heroes.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963830/

you can get the 7Days Origins + Blue Wednesday + Skel Dungeon bundle, which includes both games at a 10% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34228/Buff_Games/

Railblazer is also in development, and we'll be bringing you a demo version soon!
